suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scales))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)

out_dir <- file.path(dirname(script), "..", "docs", "output")

json_num <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return("[]")
  parts <- character(length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    v <- x[[i]]
    parts[[i]] <- if (is.na(v) && !is.nan(v)) "null"
      else if (is.nan(v)) "NaN"
      else if (is.infinite(v) && v > 0) "Infinity"
      else if (is.infinite(v) && v < 0) "-Infinity"
      else sprintf("%.17g", v)
  }
  paste0("[", paste(parts, collapse = ","), "]")
}

one <- function() {
  censor(c(-Inf, -1, 0.5, 1, 2, NA, Inf))
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf('{"value":%s,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', json_num(value), median(elapsed) * 1000))

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from scales.number import number

SHORT = {"": 0.0, "K": 1e3, "M": 1e6, "B": 1e9, "T": 1e12}


def one():
    return number(
        [12345.67, -8.2, 0, None, float("inf"), float("-inf"), 2.5e5, 1.5e6],
        big_mark=",",
        prefix="$",
        style_negative="parens",
        scale_cut=SHORT,
    )


def shown(value):
    return "NA" if value is None else value


out = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs" / "output" / "number-python.txt"
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
example = one()
out.write_text(
    "number(c(12345.67, -8.2, 0, NA, Inf, -Inf, 2.5e5, 1.5e6), "
    'big.mark = ",", prefix = "$", style_negative = "parens", '
    "scale_cut = cut_short_scale()) returns "
    + ", ".join(shown(value) for value in example)
    + ".\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))

proof.r:
.libPaths(c("/home/ahmed/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.5", .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scales))
stopifnot(packageVersion("scales") == "1.4.0")

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
file_arg <- grep("^--file=", args, value = TRUE)
script <- normalizePath(sub("^--file=", "", file_arg[[1]]))
out_dir <- file.path(dirname(script), "..", "docs", "output")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
eps <- .Machine$double.eps
example <- c(
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, 1 + eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, 1 + 99 * eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, 1 + 1001 * eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, 1 + 2 * eps), tol = eps))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(100000 * c(1, 1 + eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(100000 * c(1, 1 + 1001 * eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(0.00001 * c(1, 1 + eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(0.00001 * c(1, 1 + 1001 * eps)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, NA)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, NaN)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(1, Inf)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(-Inf, Inf)))),
  capture.output(print(zero_range(c(Inf, Inf))))
)
writeLines(example, file.path(out_dir, "zero_range-r.txt"))

json_flag <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) != 1) stop("expected one logical")
  if (is.na(x)) return("null")
  if (isTRUE(x)) return("true")
  "false"
}

one <- function() {
  zero_range(c(1, 1 + 1001 * .Machine$double.eps))
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0

cat(sprintf('{"value":%s,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', json_flag(value), median(elapsed) * 1000))

import json
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from scales.bounds import zero_range

_EPS = sys.float_info.epsilon
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs" / "output" / "zero_range-python.txt"
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
examples = [
    zero_range([1, 1 + _EPS]),
    zero_range([1, 1 + 99 * _EPS]),
    zero_range([1, 1 + 1001 * _EPS]),
    zero_range([1, 1 + 2 * _EPS], tol=_EPS),
    zero_range([100000 * 1, 100000 * (1 + _EPS)]),
    zero_range([100000 * 1, 100000 * (1 + 1001 * _EPS)]),
    zero_range([0.00001 * 1, 0.00001 * (1 + _EPS)]),
    zero_range([0.00001 * 1, 0.00001 * (1 + 1001 * _EPS)]),
    zero_range([1, None]),
    zero_range([1, float("nan")]),
    zero_range([1, float("inf")]),
    zero_range([float("-inf"), float("inf")]),
    zero_range([float("inf"), float("inf")]),
]
out.write_text("\n".join(repr(value) for value in examples) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def one():
    return zero_range([1, 1 + 1001 * _EPS])


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))
